title: Health insights
heading: Health data overview
description: Review stored measurements, compare checkups and trace every value back to its source record.
safetyNotice: This page organizes records and source-report flags only. It does not provide a diagnosis or treatment advice.

errors.catalog: Unable to load the health metric catalog.
errors.detail: Unable to load this metric’s recorded values.

empty.noPatient: Select a family member to view health data.
empty.noData: No structured lab measurements have been stored yet.
empty.noMatches: No metrics match the current filters.

vitals.title: Vital signs
vitals.description: Review stored vital-sign coverage and open the existing chart and data table for each measurement type.
vitals.partialCoverage: The server contains {{total}} records, but this directory loaded {{loaded}}. Counts by type are partial.
vitals.coverageUnknown: The total-count check is unavailable. The directory is based on the records loaded in this view.
vitals.empty: No structured vital-sign measurements have been stored for this family member.

household.title: Household overview
household.description: Compare record coverage and data quality across family members.
household.empty: No accessible family members were found.
household.memberError: This member’s summary could not be loaded.

coverage.title: Checkup coverage
coverage.description: A blank cell means no formal record is stored for that date. It does not prove the test was not performed.
coverage.excludedWithoutDate: {{count}} records without a clinical date are excluded from this matrix.
coverage.empty: No dated structured measurements are available for a coverage matrix.
coverage.noStoredRecord: No formal structured record is stored for this period

coverageEvidence.title: Coverage evidence
coverageEvidence.description: Combine recorded measurements with explicit statements that an item was not performed, not applicable, or unknown. Every statement remains versioned and traceable.
coverageEvidence.noPercentageNotice: Counts are shown as evidence only. No completion percentage is calculated because no expected-item set has been defined.
coverageEvidence.statementsDescription: Revisions create immutable versions; voiding hides the current statement while preserving its audit history.
coverageEvidence.empty: No explicit absence statements have been stored for this family member.

form.explicitNotice: Only use this form when there is explicit evidence about this exact item and date. A blank matrix cell is not evidence that an item was not performed.
form.metricHelp: Choose an existing metric when possible so evidence aligns in the matrix.

coverageEvidence.saveSuccess: The coverage statement version was saved.
coverageEvidence.saveError: Unable to save this coverage statement.
coverageEvidence.conflict: This statement changed elsewhere or duplicates a current statement. Reload before saving.
coverageEvidence.voidNotice: The current statement will disappear from the default matrix, while every version remains in history and export.
coverageEvidence.voidSuccess: The coverage statement was voided and its history was preserved.

examComparison.title: Exam comparison
examComparison.description: Compare two stored exam episodes using source documents first and lab records as a fallback.
examComparison.missingBoundary: A missing metric means no formal structured record is stored for that episode. It does not prove the test was not performed.
examComparison.partial: Only the latest {{limit}} components are loaded, so older episodes may be incomplete.
examComparison.undatedExcluded: {{count}} episodes without a clinical date are excluded from comparison.
examComparison.empty: At least two dated exam episodes are required for comparison.
examComparison.noInterpretation: Absolute difference only; no clinical direction is inferred.

selectionErrors.target_not_found: The requested target episode is unavailable; the newest pair is shown.
selectionErrors.baseline_not_found: The requested baseline episode is unavailable; the newest pair is shown.
selectionErrors.same_episode: Target and baseline cannot be the same episode; the newest pair is shown.
selectionErrors.baseline_not_earlier: The baseline must be earlier than the target; the newest pair is shown.

episode.dateConflict: This episode contains multiple clinical dates: {{dates}}

quality.title: Data quality
quality.description: These checks identify records to review. They never edit or delete health data automatically.
quality.empty: No issues were found by the current deterministic checks.

rules.low_confidence: Low parsing confidence; manual verification required

sourceWorkspace.safetyNotice: Original documents are stored separately from official measurements. Uploading a file does not parse it or write values into the health record.

entryWorkspace.title: Entry and source workspace
entryWorkspace.description: Use the currently selected family member. Store originals, prepare candidates, review them, and commit only after a separate confirmation.

actionDescriptions.lab: Add an official lab record with one or more test components.
actionDescriptions.vitals: Add measurements such as blood pressure, weight, temperature or oxygen saturation.
actionDescriptions.background: Store versioned narrative context separately from numeric measurements.

original.title: Store original
original.description: Keep the source file and verification fingerprint.

candidate.title: Prepare candidates
candidate.description: Use manual entry or the fixed CSV template.

review.title: Review every item
review.description: Resolve errors, duplicates and quality flags.

commit.title: Confirm and commit
commit.description: Write official measurements only after a separate confirmation.

sourceWorkspace.loadError: Unable to load source documents or review batches.
sourceWorkspace.documentsDescription: Keep the original report, its fingerprint and context before creating structured data.
sourceWorkspace.documentsEmpty: No source documents are stored for this family member.
sourceWorkspace.batchesDescription: Parser output stays here until each candidate is reviewed. This summary does not commit any values.
sourceWorkspace.batchesEmpty: No review batches have been created.
sourceWorkspace.uploadNotice: This action stores the original file only. It does not extract, analyze or import health values.
sourceWorkspace.uploadSuccessMessage: The file and its verification fingerprint were saved. No health values were imported.
sourceWorkspace.uploadErrorMessage: The original document could not be stored.
sourceWorkspace.duplicateWarning: An identical file is already stored for this family member. Keep another copy only when the duplicate is intentional.

lifecycle.withdrawNotice: The original will be hidden from the default list and blocked from new import batches. Its file, history and existing measurements will remain intact.
lifecycle.restoreNotice: The original will return to the default list and may be used for new review batches.
lifecycle.preserveDependencies: All linked records will remain intact. Withdrawal only stops future use; it does not rewrite existing trends or history.
lifecycle.reasonPlaceholder: For example: uploaded to the wrong member
lifecycle.withdrawSuccessMessage: The original is hidden from the default list while its file and history remain intact.
lifecycle.loadErrorMessage: The linked records for this original could not be loaded. Try again.
lifecycle.actionErrorMessage: The original's status could not be updated. Try again.

sourceReview.title: Review batch #{{batch}}
sourceReview.notice: Saving review decisions does not write to the official health record. Committing requires a separate confirmation.
sourceReview.selectDecision: Accept or ignore at least one candidate.
sourceReview.overrideRequired: Explain why this identified duplicate should still be accepted.
sourceReview.savedMessage: Candidate decisions were saved. Nothing was written to the official record.
sourceReview.commitConfirmMessage: Only accepted candidates will be written to the official record. This action is audited and can be rolled back as a batch while the imported records remain unchanged.
sourceReview.rollbackConfirmMessage: Only records created by this batch will be removed. Rollback stops if an imported record was changed or is referenced elsewhere.
sourceReview.commitSuccess: Accepted candidates were written to the official record.
sourceReview.rollbackSuccess: Official records created by this batch were rolled back.
sourceReview.subjectMismatchWarningTitle: The detected name may not match this record
sourceReview.subjectMismatchWarningMessage: Check that the report belongs to the current record. The system will not move it to another person automatically.
sourceReview.subjectMismatchMayBeOcrError: Text recognition can be wrong. This is a review warning, not an identity conclusion.
sourceReview.subjectMismatchConfirmTitle: Still commit to the current record?
sourceReview.subjectMismatchConfirmMessage: The detected name may differ from the current record. Accepted candidates are written only after this confirmation.
sourceReview.subjectMismatchAcknowledge: I checked the original and confirm committing to the current record
sourceReview.rollbackError: Unable to roll back this batch.
sourceReview.noEvidenceText: No extracted source text is available for this candidate.

csv.title: Import a lab CSV into review
csv.description: Use the fixed template and preview every row before creating a review batch.
csv.notice: Previewing checks the file in memory only. It does not create official measurements or save the uploaded CSV.
csv.blocked: Fix every invalid row before creating the review batch.
csv.reviewNotice: All rows passed the deterministic checks. Review and edit the candidates below before creating the batch.

errors.invalid_date: Use a supported calendar date format.
errors.unsafe_formula: Spreadsheet formulas are not allowed in text fields.
errors.invalid_page: Use a positive whole-number source page.
errors.invalid_reference_range: Reference minimum must be lower than maximum.
errors.invalid_candidate: The row does not satisfy the candidate contract.
errors.duplicate_header: Each template field may appear only once.
errors.missing_header: A required template column is missing.
errors.unexpected_columns: The row contains more cells than the header.
errors.row_limit: The CSV contains more than 500 non-empty data rows.

sourceEntry.title: Create a manual review batch
sourceEntry.notice: These entries stay in a review batch. They do not become official health measurements until they are reviewed and committed separately.
sourceEntry.missingRequired: Complete each metric name and result before creating the review batch.
sourceEntry.invalidRange: A reference minimum must be lower than its maximum.
sourceEntry.successMessage: The candidates are ready for review. No official health measurements were created.
sourceEntry.error: Unable to create the review batch.

healthAlerts.title: Alerts
healthAlerts.description: Every alert shows its evidence, source, rule version and limitations.
healthAlerts.safetyNotice: These alerts only organize stored records using visible, deterministic rules. They are not a diagnosis, risk score or treatment recommendation.
healthAlerts.rulesDescription: Rules use exact metric names and units from stored records.
healthAlerts.testNameHelp: Use the exact name shown in the metric catalog.
healthAlerts.overdueEvidence: Rule: more than {{days}} days; currently {{elapsed}} days since the latest stored record.

explanations.source_status: The latest stored result carries an attention label supplied by its source report.
explanations.threshold: The latest stored numeric value matched this user-configured comparison.
explanations.overdue: The elapsed time since the latest stored result exceeded this user-configured interval.

limitationsText.source_status: This repeats a source-report label; it does not independently interpret or diagnose the result.
limitationsText.threshold: This is a user-configured numeric comparison, not a clinical reference range, diagnosis or risk score.
limitationsText.overdue: This only measures time since the latest stored record. It cannot show whether a test was clinically due or performed elsewhere.

healthBackground.title: Health background
healthBackground.description: Keep time-versioned narrative context separate from numeric measurements and trace each version to its source.
healthBackground.versionNotice: Revisions create a new version instead of overwriting history. Voided versions remain available in the audit history.
healthBackground.empty: No narrative health background has been stored for this family member.
healthBackground.saveSuccess: The health background version was saved.
healthBackground.saveError: Unable to save this health background version.
healthBackground.conflict: This entry changed elsewhere. Reload it before saving.
healthBackground.voidSuccess: The entry was voided while its history was preserved.
healthBackground.voidNotice: Voiding hides this entry from the default timeline but preserves every version for audit and export.

export.noData: No observations are available to export.
export.unitMismatch: Multiple units are present, so no combined series is drawn.
export.disclaimer: This export organizes stored records and is not a diagnosis.

vitalExport.visualLimit: SVG and print are limited to {{limit}} observations; CSV remains complete.

date.title: Date window
date.description: Apply an exact date window to the selected series. Start and end dates are included.

errors.reversed: The start date cannot be after the end date.

baseline.title: Baseline comparison
baseline.description: Compare the latest record in this window with one exact earlier record.
baseline.noInterpretation: Arithmetic difference only; no clinical direction is inferred.

reasons.insufficient_points: At least two stored records are required for a baseline comparison.
reasons.missing_value: These records do not contain compatible values for a comparison.
reasons.invalid_baseline: The selected baseline is not an earlier record in the current window.
reasons.incompatible_unit: The baseline and target units do not match.

source.notFound: Source document {{document}} is not available for the current family member.

visualizationContext.limitReached: This view loaded the newest {{limit}} records. Earlier records may exist; narrow the date window before choosing a baseline.

detail.selectMetric: Select a metric to inspect its records.
detail.unitMismatch: Multiple units were returned. Values are not shown as one comparable series.
detail.noObservations: No observations available for this metric.
detail.comparisonAria: Discrete comparison of recorded values by date
detail.trendAria: Long-term line chart of recorded values by date

sourceParse.title: Parse report locally
sourceParse.notice: Parsing runs on this server and creates review candidates only. Values reach official trends only after item review and a separate commit.

readiness.title: Files currently supported
readiness.partialHint: Unavailable formats stop safely and keep the original. Digital PDFs are unaffected by missing image OCR components.

worker.running: Background tasks continue automatically, including recovery after a service restart.
worker.fallback: The continuous worker is not running; this request still uses the safe fallback processor.

sourceParse.processing: Extracting text and recognizing core laboratory metrics
sourceParse.processingHint: You may close this window. Task state is retained and the original is never rewritten.
sourceParse.successNotice: Parsing finished. This is a candidate summary; official health data still has 0 writes.
sourceParse.failedTitle: This report could not be parsed automatically
sourceParse.originalPreserved: The original file remains intact. Retry or use manual entry.
sourceParse.cancelledNotice: The parsing task was cancelled. The original and all other data are unchanged.
sourceParse.staleNotice: This task has not finished for 30 minutes and may have been interrupted by a service restart. It can be safely rescheduled.
sourceParse.startErrorMessage: The parsing task could not be created. Try again.
sourceParse.retryError: Unable to restart the parsing task.
sourceParse.openBatchError: Unable to open the generated review batch.

errors.source_archived: The original is withdrawn. Restore it before parsing.
errors.source_file_missing: The stored original file is missing.
errors.source_hash_mismatch: The original fingerprint changed, so processing stopped.
errors.ocr_unavailable: Local OCR is not installed on the server. Digital PDFs can still be parsed.
errors.ocr_language_unavailable: OCR is missing Chinese or English language data.
errors.unsupported_image_codec: This image encoding is not readable. Convert it to JPG, PNG or PDF and retry.
errors.unsupported_source_type: This file type is outside the current local parser scope.
errors.source_page_limit_exceeded: The report exceeds the local parsing page limit.
errors.image_pixel_limit_exceeded: The image is too large to process safely.
errors.extracted_text_limit_exceeded: Extracted text exceeds the safety limit.
errors.text_extraction_failed: No usable text could be extracted from the report.
errors.no_supported_candidates: The report was read, but no first-release core metrics were recognized. Use manual entry.
errors.task_owner_missing: The task owner account is missing.
errors.parse_internal_error: An internal parsing error occurred. No official data was written.
errors.unknown: Parsing did not finish. No official data was written.
